kate_sales: Heads-up: AtlasTrust (prospect) put two must-haves in their LOI: (1) emergency key swap so new encrypts use rotated key within 3 minutes, (2) invoice must show an HSM-call line per API request for internal cost allocation. They also asked about an on-site key-import ceremony and a signed attestation artifact. Need feasibility + quick SOW language.

omar_se: Clarify the 3m requirement: they want new writes to avoid old wrapping keys within 3m, right? or full CRL/deny-old across all regions?

kate_sales: They only asked that new writes use new keys within 3 minutes. Historical decrypts can run for 48h. But they're firm on the 3m for new writes.

diego_eng: Technically doable with coordinated steps: create/import new key in their KMS, push wrapping key to our HSM proxy nodes, evict keycache, optionally force TLS session rehandshake. Forced eviction will likely cause a short spike in errors and tail latency while clients reconnect. We'll estimate error + latency delta.

lee_sre: Runbook (high level): 1) customer initiates rotation 2) Redwood pushes new wrapping key to proxies 3) send cache-invalidate RPCs and rotate proxy session certs to force reconnects 4) start serving new writes 5) monitor error rate and rollback if >X%. Emergency path: skip canary, apply immediately. Recommend documenting expected transient error window (30-90s).

mina_security: Security checklist: we need the HSM vendor attestation, proof of FIPS level if requested, and whether AtlasTrust requires an M-of-N import ceremony (on-site). On-site ceremony adds weeks and an extra SOW line item. Signed audit artifacts for rotation events are doable; specify retention. Internal link: https://redwood.internal/sec/byo-kms.

jules_billing: Billing: we can add SKU BYO_HSM_CALL and surface it as a separate invoice line. Requires engineering to emit metering tags per proxied request. Pricing options: per-call, tiered discounts, or commit+overage. Kate, did they propose a number?

kate_sales: They floated $0.0075 per HSM call and asked for visibility by route/model. Also asked invoice csv export with per-call counts.

diego_eng: Cost note: $0.0075 is okay at mid-volume but we should recommend commit for steady-state. Also telem overhead for per-call tags is small but nonzero. For rotation, worst-case added latency if HSM unwrap per request ~120-300ms; with warm caches and pooling 95th can be ~100-150ms.

lee_sre: Network: prefer PrivateLink or VPC peering over NAT for predictable egress IPs. Firewall rules: allow outbound 443 to proxy IPs and ephemeral ports. I'll paste a TF snippet if needed.

legal-bot: Draft SOW language suggestion: "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to begin serving new write requests encrypted with newly-rotated keys within three (3) minutes of rotation initiation. Emergency revocation may require forced cache invalidation and TLS session renegotiation which can produce transient elevated error rates; Redwood will provide signed rotation audit artifacts upon Customer request. Exceptions include network partitions and force majeure." If AtlasTrust insists on a firm SLA, propose a measurable metric (e.g., "95% of new write requests in Customer's primary region will use the new key within 3 minutes").

mina_security: Also include a clause about ceremony & attestation fees: "On-site key-import ceremonies and vendor attestation gathering are available for an additional fee and require minimum 3-week lead time."

jules_billing: Action items: (1) I'll mock an invoice sample + CSV layout, (2) Kate -> confirm proposed per-call price and whether they'd accept commit model, (3) Diego -> short latency/error matrix for forced vs staged rotation at 50/200/800 rps, (4) Lee -> network template + PrivateLink vs peering pros/cons, (5) Mina -> exact doc checklist for attestation & retention.

kate_sales: I'll check with AtlasTrust on commit vs per-call and confirm ceremony requirement. Scheduling a 15m call after we have the matrix. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
